RORDI_WORKSPACE.description: The Rordi workspace this installation belongs to. Copy it from your Rordi workspace settings page.

RORDI_PAIRING_CODE.description: One-time pairing code from Rordi. It expires shortly and can only be used **once** — generate a fresh one if this deploy fails.

RORDI_BRIDGE_KEY.description: Installation key from Rordi, shown next to the pairing code. This Worker signs its identity with it; Rordi never receives it from you.
